nom: Lierac - Hydragenist - Le Gel-Crème Réhydratant Éclat 50ml - Soin Visage - Réhydrate - Rafraîchit - Illumine - 98% d’ingrédients d’origine naturelle - Peaux normales à mixtes même sensibles

avis.texte: apres plus de 20 ans de problemes de creme visage, je suis super heureuse d'avoir enfin trouver celle qui est faite pour mon visage, resultats juste top. mon visage est nourit et mon teint illumine.
Ce gel hydratant pour le visage est présenté dans un joli flacon en verre, il est rechargeable, non gras, facile à appliquer.

avis.titre: Ingredientes de calidad, piel iluminada e hidratada
avis.texte: Me encanta esta marca de cosméticos por lo efectivos que son y los ingredientes naturales que utilizan. Esta crema me está gustando mucho, su textura es en gel y me deja la piel muy nutrida sin aspecto pegajoso. La utilizo todos los días después de aplicarme un serum y antes de la base de maquillaje y no necesito utilizar más producto el resto del día, con lo cual me dura bastante el bote. La app yuca le da la máxima puntuación en relación a sus ingredientes. Para mi este producto es una maravilla.

avis.titre: Burning, Redness, and Tingling When Using, 2nd jar also compromisedBurning, Redness, and Tingling When Using, 2nd jar al
avis.texte: I used the product exactly as intended (twice) and had a severe skin reaction (burning and redness). This is not a mild sensitivity — I look like I got a chemical peel. I believe this batch may be compromised. As a customer of Lierac products for the past 8 years (albeit only ever buying in Paris, not in the U.S.), I have never had this reaction before. I’ve never had this reaction to any products minus products exclusively for chemical peels. **Update** received the replacement 3 days later and this is not at all like the quality I receive back home in Paris. When I opened the jar the cream pot was stuck to the lid. I then realized that the entire cream pot had cut away. Somehow it had been chopped off. You can’t tell as well in the photo but it’s like someone took a knife and chopped off the top of the pot. It’s jagged and I can’t figure out how this was possible if the pot and the jar were packaged together. It’s still sealed, the seal is just stuck to the lid of the pot, and hacked off halfway (what even?). This seller is selling cheap products. I’m starting to wonder if they’re even authorized to sell Lierac because this is not the quality of product I get in France. Twice I’ve had problems and it doesn’t seem like it will corrected on the 3rd try. I will have to contact Lierac to ask for an authorized chemist because I don’t think this seller is.
Har använt i några år nu. Bra produkt. Hjälper verkligen huden att bli återfuktad!! Nöjd!!!!
